in_sanskrit.name: कृष्का
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: derived from 'Krish' (meaning 'dark, black, or all-attractive') and the suffix '-ka' (meaning 'little' or 'beloved')

in_marathi.name: Krishika
in_marathi.long_meaning: Krishika हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the name Krishna, meaning 'dark' or 'black'. In Hindu mythology, Krishna is a god known for his mischievous pranks as a child and his later role as a savior and protector. Krishika is a feminine variation of this name, often given to girls born during the time of Krishna's worship.
